name: ${optifabric_name}
description: Loads OptiFine into Fabric. Put the OptiFine jar for ${minecraft_version} into the mods folder next to this mod; ${optifabric_name} patches, remaps and applies it at runtime. OptiFine itself is not bundled or redistributed. This is the alternative 1.20.6 build: it does not claim the id optifabric, so mods whose metadata refuses that id (c2me does on this release) can load next to it. Install only one of the two 1.20.6 builds.

custom._comment: OptiFine is a terrain renderer, so Indigo must step aside. Fabric's own hook for that (Sodium declares the same value): IndigoMixinConfigPlugin.shouldApplyMixin returns false for every fabric-renderer-indigo mixin, and Indigo skips registering its renderer. Without it ChunkBuilderBuiltChunkRebuildTaskMixin fails fatally, because its @Inject targets BlockPos.iterate inside ChunkBuilder.BuiltChunk.RebuildTask.render and OptiFine's rewrite of that loop removes the call.
